about: Label Check - our own product list. Products that Open Food Facts / Open Beauty Facts do not have. The app checks this list first, also offline. Product data from the label only: no photos, nothing personal. code = the barcode digits (empty if not known yet: then find the product with Search). kind = food or cosmetic. lang = language of the ingredient text (en, de, bg).
